title: AR-2 — CRITICAL-PATH TEST PYRAMID FREEZE
purpose: Freeze the smallest complete, owner-aligned, deterministic test pyramid proving the Alpha consequential Product path and launch-critical invariants.

criticalPaths.semantic: Organization and tenant confinement
Authorization is renewed before protected loading
Denied, foreign, stale, revoked, absent, malformed, unavailable, and withheld states disclose one neutral shape
Owner-issued Product Question, series, occurrence, operation, receipt, and replay identity
Exact replay, incompatible replay, and CAS conflict remain typed and distinct
Private Working is user-scoped and non-authoritative
Intentional contribution persists only explicit selections and permits the truthful empty boundary
Freeze is owner-issued, durable, and idempotent
Capture binds the exact frozen occurrence without importing private material
Review records explicit disposition over exact captured material
Closure is truthful, immutable, and binds Freeze, Capture, Review, organization, question, series, occurrence, user, and authorization
What Changed appears only after truthful closure
Prepare Again is explicit and owner-issued
Successor preserves exact Product Question and recurring-series lineage while receiving a distinct occurrence identity
Occurrence 2 is prepared and truthfully not started
Accepted state reconstructs after hard reload
Accepted state reconstructs in a fresh server and operating-system/browser process
Runtime and Product Workflow recover deterministically from interruption without changing canonical schemas
Runtime-to-Workflow materialization is atomic, idempotent, and fresh-process reconstructable
Joined owner inventory has exact cross-owner correspondence
Canonical record families contain zero missing and disallowed duplicate identities
Foreign owner state and ambiguous resource groups remain byte-identical
AR-3 observations are closed, content-safe, ordered, and non-influential
AR-4 telemetry is consent-gated, pseudonymous, bounded, expiring, deletable, and cannot influence Product or recovery
Authenticated CEO, Director, Manager, and denied behavior is correct at desktop and narrow viewports
Acknowledgement-lost partial external provisioning is rediscovered only by exact task ownership
Every valid external run executes cleanup attempt one and idempotent cleanup attempt two
A distinct process and fresh client prove exact task-scoped zero
Protected-value scanner is sensitive and all public surfaces contain zero findings
Evidence is source-bound, deterministic, closed, and adjudicated only by PRE-001A
Repository type, lint, build, governance, architecture, and dependency identities remain governed
